description: Controlled vocabulary for EchoFinder manual tagging. All tag values in legacy_artists.json and modern_candidate_pool.json should draw from these categories. Free-text fields (production_style, vocal_style, scene_lineage, notes) are descriptive prose and are not controlled.

genres.description: Primary musical genre classification. Each artist should have 2-4 genres.
genres.usage_notes: Prefer existing values. Add new values only when no existing value fits, and update this taxonomy.

emotional_tones.description: The emotional character or mood of the artist's music.
emotional_tones.usage_notes: List 2-4 tones per artist. Tones are not mutually exclusive.

lyrical_themes.description: Recurring subjects and themes in the artist's lyrics.
lyrical_themes.usage_notes: List 2-5 themes per artist. Use the most specific existing value.

raw_tags.description: Freeform tags used by the scoring engine for tag similarity calculations. These are a flattening of genres and subgenres into a single set.
raw_tags.usage_notes: The tags field in both legacy_artists.json and modern_candidate_pool.json is used for automated scoring. Keep values aligned with genres. Normalization rules in scoring.py handle case-folding and aliases.

production_style.description: Descriptive prose note about production approach. Not a controlled field.

vocal_style.description: Descriptive prose note about vocal characteristics. Not a controlled field.

scene_lineage.description: Descriptive prose noting regional and historical scene context. Not a controlled field.

notes.description: General notes about the artist's significance and context. Not a controlled field.
